newsitem.title: USA: American Medical stake cut by Gabelli.
newsitem.headline: American Medical stake cut by Gabelli.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it cut its stake in American Medical Response Inc to 100 common shares, or less than one percent, from 6.04 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 1,474,000 common shares sold between January 29, 1996, and February 14 at prices ranging from $39.50 to $40 per share.
As a result of a tender offer by Laidlaw Inc, the group ceased to be beneficial owners of more than five percent on February 14, 1997, the filing said.
American Medical, based in Boston, Mass., provides pre-hospital emergency medical care and ambulance services to patients in response to "911" emergency medical calls.
